pr_records.title: Make DAB RF scan results clickable and group peaks by nominal blocks
pr_records.body:
## Reported problem
The user observed a completed DAB spectrum scan with 6 measured RF peaks (178.383, 197.117, 197.805, 207.602, 222.039, 222.555 MHz) and could not click or open any result. The old `displaySurvey` rendered inert `div.scan-row` elements except the FM-only TRY RDS button.

## Changes
- Group energy peaks against the published European Band III nominal DAB raster and 1.536-MHz DAB block width (e.g. 222.039 + 222.555 MHz both map to the potential **11D** block centre at 222.064 MHz). Distinguish 6 peaks from 4 *possible* blocks; do not claim any ensemble, station, FIC decode, DLS or signal lock.
- Render keyboard/touch-accessible expandable `details` for each possible DAB block with centre frequency, recorded peaks, observed power and explicit unverified status.
- On the user's **CHECK DECODER & SAVED TEXT** click only, inspect installed `welle-cli` and existing locally imported `dab_dls` / `journaline` archives. No tuning or network fetch is triggered. DAB decoder not connected remains conspicuously indicated.
- Preserve unmatched raw peaks and manual FM RDS actions, add inspect controls for other non-FM energy bands.
- Add synthetic regression tests and scanning docs. No modifications to hardware owner, RDS, Flight Radar or unrelated service APIs.

## Validation required
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- `python3 -m compileall -q textcenter tests`
- `node --check web/app.js`
- Real mobile/desktop accessibility check and hardware receiver acceptance still pending. CI uses mocks; no actual DAB lock is claimed.
- Upstream reference: https://www.ukwtv.de/cms/dab-kanaele.html

## Remaining
**Real DAB station browsing requires a connected welle-compatible DAB decoder**. It is separate from this frequency-raster UI repair and should be developed behind the shared SDR broker, without exposing an untrusted welle-cli HTTP listener or interfering with existing ADS-B/recording services. Continue [issue #2](https://github.com/Tihulu/TIHULU-TEXT-CENTER/issues/2). Keep draft/unmerged until CI and review.
pr_records.author: Tihulu

pr_records.title: Display live backend version instead of stale footer label
pr_records.body:
## Issue
The browser footer hardcoded `0.3` even while `textcenter.__version__` on `main` is already `0.4.0` or newer. An earlier screenshot showed `0.2`, which therefore cannot reliably establish whether the running backend exposes current scan features.

## Fix
- Populate the footer version from `/api/bootstrap` (already fetched for counts and CSRF).
- Retain a neutral placeholder before API connectivity is established.
- Add an HTTP regression check for the footer element and backend version contract.

## Verification
Use existing GitHub Actions test suite; live browser and hardware testing is not claimed. No RF device is opened, no background requests added, and the standalone application structure is preserved.

## Operational note
After pulling, restart the Python server and hard-refresh the browser; source updates cannot update a previously running Python process automatically.

## CI status at review time
The PR workflow currently fails in the unrelated **pre-existing main-branch RDS2 image test**: `test_RDS2_logo_option_default_off_and_verified_file_persisted` (`saved_images` expected 1, got 0). The identical failure was reproduced in main run https://github.com/Tihulu/TIHULU-TEXT-CENTER/actions/runs/42146580671. The UI version-label HTTP test passed. Keep this draft PR unmerged until main's RDS2 regression is corrected and CI is green.
pr_records.author: Tihulu

pr_records.title: Fail closed on unverified LF/HF scans for NESDR SMArt v5 Q-branch
pr_records.body:
## Verified issue
Nooelec documents NESDR SMArt v5 HF reception via **Q-branch** direct sampling. The stock osmocom `rtl_power -D` implementation selects **I-branch** (`verbose_direct_sampling(dev, 1)`), so the previous implementation exposed LF/HF scans that may silently produce misleading empty results on this hardware.

## Change
- Keep all seven catalogued RF profiles visible; disable only DRM, RTTY, NAVTEX and WeatherFAX LF/HF survey initiation until a tested Q-branch-capable backend is provided.
- Block incompatible low-level command construction as well as UI/API preflight.
- Add synthetic regression tests for all four blocked profiles and preserve FM/DAB/APRS VHF survey availability.
- Update README and scanning documentation; no effect on FM RDS live decode, archives, DVB, Internet feeds or Flight Radar.

## Evidence
- Nooelec: https://support.nooelec.com/hc/en-us/articles/10470422657047-NESDR-SMArt-v5-FAQ
- osmocom `rtl_power`: https://github.com/osmocom/rtl-sdr/blob/master/src/rtl_power.c

## Validation
**Pending GitHub Actions**: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`, `python3 -m compileall -q textcenter tests`, `node --check web/app.js`. This PR does not claim real receiver/hardware acceptance. Do not merge until CI and physical scanner selection are reviewed.

## Follow-up
Implement explicit I/Q selection and actual Nooelec Q-branch HF capture through an appropriate backend behind the shared Survival Kit device lease; add true protocol decoders independently. This change is a safety/correctness guard, **not** a completed HF feature.
pr_records.author: Tihulu
